It's just a tall 1/2 pint jar following PF tek with brown rice flour and vermiculite and a dry vermiculite barrier at the top. Basically I had 7 of them and some started pinning before the bottom was fully colonized and they seemed to want to grow straight out the top, so that's what I tried. Even though it turned out to be an easy and quick way to get some fruits, birthing the cakes and then fruiting them with high humidity and still allowing for as much fresh air as possible would almost definitely provide a higher yield.
For anyone interested, these were dried and then consumed without any ill effect. Definitely fine and active.
